text:
Mika: Downsizing before the move — giving away a barely-used bamboo standing desk (60x30) + commuter bits: Brompton folding bike helmet (M), reflective rain cover for backpack, unused March muni pass, and an anti-fatigue standing mat. Free to pickup in SoMa. DM to claim. Photo: https://imgur.com/a/abcd123
Sam: Wait, a free desk?? 😲
Chloe: That mat + desk combo is chef's kiss. Interested in the mat if still available.
Ravi: I can help pickup the desk Sat morning if it's still free. Will bring a friend to help lift.
Mika: Cool — pickup windows:```Fri 6:00-7:00pm
Sat 10:00am-12:00pm```Address: 123 Minna St (buzzer: "Redwood"). DM me to confirm exact time. Helmet reserved on first DM.
Sam: DM sent, I can do Fri 6:15. Helmet please :)
Chloe: DMing now for the mat. If it’s not too bulky I can carry it on BART.
Ravi: Sat 10 works for the desk — if someone else beats me to it I totally understand. No trade offers pls, trying to clear stuff.
DevOps-bot: Reminder: avoid pasting full personal addresses in public channels. Use DMs for exact pickup details. :robot_face:
Mika: Thanks for the heads up — I'll DM everyone. Helmet -> Sam, Mat -> Chloe, Desk tentatively -> Ravi until Sat 10. If anything changes I'll post an update here.
Sam: Thanks! Will bring a small backpack for the helmet and a :thumbsup:
Chloe: Appreciate it. If the mat is heavy I can ask a friend to help.
Ravi: If the desk needs disassembly I can bring basic tools. Anyone have a second pair of hands for carrying?
Mika: Bring tools just in case. If the desk goes to Ravi, I'll include screws and an extra allen key.
Sam: Love a free allen key.
Mika: End of thread update will go here after pickup — keeping it tidy. :)
